headline: Saudi Exchange Listed Companies See Intangible Assets Surge to SR5.78 Trillion
summary: The Saudi Authority for Intellectual Property reported that intangible assets owned by listed companies reached SR5.78 trillion, making up 65.6% of overall market value.
why: Intangible asset valuations reflect IP, brand equity, and technology adoption across Saudi Arabia's capital market.

impacts.name: Tadawul All Share Index
impacts.why: Listed Saudi firms recorded high intangible asset proportions relative to market capitalization.
